title: A Pelican Crashes Into the Sea From 60 Feet Up and Walks Away

scenes.text: This bird dives into the ocean from 60 feet up.
That's a six-story drop, head first, straight into water.
It's a brown pelican, and it does this all day.
Air sacs under its chest skin act like cushions on impact.
It also twists slightly left, to protect its windpipe.
Sixty feet, face first, and dinner is waiting.

description:
This bird dives into the ocean from 60 feet up.
Brown pelicans use air sacs under the skin of their chest as cushions and turn slightly left in the air to protect their throat.
Would you ever jump from that high into water? Comment below.
first_comment: Pelicans dive at a steep angle, 60 to 90 degrees, to aim through the water's glare. Would you try it?
